MOUNTAIN + JUNGLE WEBSITE FILLER PACK

All artwork is supplied as a transparent PNG and matches the supplied terracotta folk-mural scene.

FILES
01-left-jungle-mountain.png
  Place at the left edge. Anchor bottom-left. Scale until its low inner edge points toward the central Ravan composition.

02-right-jungle-mountain.png
  Place at the right edge. Anchor bottom-right. It is intentionally different from the left mountain.

03-distant-mountain-range.png
  Place behind the central figures. Stretch across most of the viewport and reduce opacity slightly if you want more depth.

04-foreground-jungle-cliff.png
  Place across the lower edge, in front of the background but behind important UI and characters.

05-floating-jungle-island.png
  Use as a secondary island in the left or right empty space. Scale it smaller than the main Shiva/Ravan platform.

06-falling-rocks-small.png
  Place below or beside a floating island. Animate only a tiny downward drift for a restrained effect.

07-falling-rocks-large.png
  Use nearer the viewer or underneath the main platform. Rotate the complete layer if you need the cascade to fall in another direction.

SUGGESTED LAYER ORDER
1. Terracotta background
2. Distant mountain range
3. Left and right jungle mountains
4. Main character artwork and floating island
5. Extra floating island
6. Falling-rock overlays
7. Foreground jungle cliff
8. Website UI

For a calm living-painting effect, move the rock overlays only 4 to 10 pixels during a long scroll section. Keep the mountains fixed or use very slow parallax.
